description: Creates a new note immediately when of is omitted. With of, replaces an unchanged note only after this caller has read its complete current text, retaining the previous text in History. Unread, changed or open notes receive a separate proposal for review. The applied receipt states whether the requested change was written immediately.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

of.description: The listed note to update. Omit to create a new note.

operation_id.description: Optional retry identity scoped to this principal, connection and document. An unchanged mutation replays its original result for 24 hours, even after later edits; its expired identity never executes again. A read replays while its receipt is retained; after 256 later reads it executes afresh. Reusing an identity with changed arguments refuses. Visual observations are fresh. Inspect before starting another operation. Calls without it never replay.

text.description: The complete Markdown for the new note or replacement.

title.description: A title for a new note or review proposal; direct replacements use text unchanged.

name: notes.propose

applied.description: true for an immediate creation or replacement; false when the requested update waits for review.

document.description: The document value rapier.open returned. With a connected host it names the workspace and the connection is the authority; without one it is the workspace's whole authority, so keep it private.

file.description: The created or updated note, or the separate proposal file when applied is false.

title: Create or update a note
